Real-world sample files used by the tests.

Source: the MPXJ project's test data (https://github.com/joniles/mpxj, `junit/data/`),
licensed LGPL 2.1. Copied unchanged; renamed for clarity.

| file | origin | what it exercises |
|---|---|---|
| p6_complete_activity.xer | PredecessorCalendar.xer | real P6 calendar blob with exceptions; complete activity without actual dates |
| p6_percent_complete.xer | generated/task-percentcomplete/percent-complete-8.4.xer | duration / physical / units percent-complete types |
| p6_percent_complete.pmxml | generated/task-percentcomplete/percent-complete-8.4.pmxml | P6 XML reader |
| msproject_relations.xml | mspdirelations.xml | MSPDI link types and lags |
| msproject_sample.mpp | legacy/sample.mpp | binary MS Project via the optional MPXJ bridge |
